text:
maria: Heads-up — opened a PR that fixes a KV cache retention bug causing token leakage on long chat sessions. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before merge. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/22456. TL;DR: changes eviction policy and adds an optional short-term disk spill fallback for huge contexts. Risk: possible transient data on disk if fallback triggers. Asking @lee (runtime), @ashok (eng-infra), @olivia (security) for review/approval. Prefer a canary in tomorrow's 14:00-15:00 PT window. cc @jonathan @sara :eyes:

lee: looking now. biggest concern is potential p99 latency regression from spill path. can you add microbench numbers and a simple perf test? also please add unit test for eviction logic.

maria: added perf numbers to the PR description (local microbench attached) and included a unit test for eviction. brief code diff: `if current_kv_bytes + delta > MAX_KV_BYTES: evict_prefix()`

ashok: infra note — the disk spill currently writes to /var/tmp by default. we should make that opt-in via a helm flag and a pod-level sandbox path. i'll add a suggested helm var and rollout steps in the PR.

olivia: sec note — need a short threat model and a scrubber hook before any spill to disk. also confirm no secrets or raw user PII can be written. can you add a checklist entry and example scrubber? i'll leave a comment with suggested checklist items.

jonathan: if runtime/infra/sec give +1 i can merge during the 14:00 PT slot. i'm owning the merge window and can monitor canary. any objections to that timing?

sara: quick q — does this touch embedding-service KV or only the runtime decoder cache?

maria: only runtime decoder KV cache. embeddings path unaffected.

lee: nit: style comment in the code, and please add a small integration test for end-to-end decode with spill enabled. otherwise i'm 👍 pending infra & sec.

ashok: added helm var `enable_kv_spill` + config map example in the PR. suggested rollout: enable in canary namespace -> watch metrics -> graduate.

olivia: requested explicit scrubber example. left a code comment with pseudocode: `if contains_pii(chunk): scrub(chunk)` and suggested KMS gating for any persisted artifacts. also filing a short audit ticket for this change.

deploy-bot: ci/checks — unit + integration passed, flake8 failed on one file. details: https://ci.redwood/checks/22456

maria: fixed flake8, pushed another commit. thanks :pray:

jonathan: sounds good. @lee @ashok @olivia can you give final thumbs? plan to merge at 14:00 PT if no objections.

lee: +1. monitoring perf in canary.

ashok: +1 infra. will monitor disks and autoscaler behavior during canary.

olivia: +1 sec assuming scrubber hook remains and audit ticket is tracked. leaving follow-up JIRA for compliance.

sara: note to self — update release notes with `KV spill opt-in` and short rationale.

maria: thanks everyone — scheduling merge at 14:00 PT and will post status updates in this thread. :rocket:
